title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by the equation: $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$. We need to determine if $$f(x)=x$$ can fit the data in the scatterplot.

title: Analyzing the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot. Does the data appear to follow a linear trend? If so, $$f(x)=x$$ might be a suitable function.

title: Linear Relationship
text: If the data points form a straight line or can be approximated by a straight line, then $$f(x)=x$$ is likely a good fit.

title: Conclusion
